name: kreator
description: Kreator Studio - open creator workspace (AI video, image, voice, translation) inspired by OpenCreator

scripts.build: npm --workspace @kreator/web run build && npm --workspace @kreator/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @kreator/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @kreator/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace @kreator/server run test && npm --workspace @kreator/web run test
